description: Search 3.5M+ open-access research outputs on Zenodo — publications, datasets, software, presentations, posters, videos, and more. Filter by type, access right (open/embargoed/restricted), and publication date range. Sort by relevance, recency, most-viewed, or most-downloaded. Each result includes DOI, title, creators, resource type, access right, keywords, view/download stats, and a direct URL. Zenodo is operated by CERN under the OpenAIRE program and hosts research from EU-funded projects, science institutions worldwide, and individual researchers. All metadata is CC0.

access_right.description: Filter by access right: "open" (freely downloadable), "embargoed", "restricted", or "closed".

date_from.description: Filter records published on or after this date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2023-01-01").

date_to.description: Filter records published on or before this date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2024-12-31").

limit.description: Number of results to return per page (default 10, max 50).

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Combine with limit for paging.

query.description: Free-text search query across title, description, creators, and keywords (e.g. "CRISPR gene editing", "climate change datasets", "machine learning").

sort.description: Sort order: "bestmatch" (relevance), "mostrecent" (newest first), "mostviewed", or "mostdownloaded". Default: bestmatch.

name: zenodo.records.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Zenodo Research Records
